name: edinburghcocktailweek-map
description: Unofficial interactive map of Edinburgh Cocktail Week 2026 bars: £6 Signature and £9 Prestige cocktails, filters and distances from you

paragraphs: An interactive map of every bar in Edinburgh Cocktail Week: the £6 Signature and £9 Prestige cocktail lists, plus the Cocktail Village. The official site lists the bars but has no map, so this site plots them.

It's a static site with no build step. The map is MapLibre GL JS (BSD-3-Clause), loaded from jsDelivr. The basemap is drawn from embedded OpenStreetMap vector data, so there's no tile server or API key. Map labels use Noto Sans (SIL Open Font License), with the glyph files self-hosted in public/fonts/. Cocktail photos are loaded from Edinburgh Cocktail Week's own image CDN, not copied into this repo.
features: Pins are coloured by area, and Prestige bars are gold-edged diamonds. Click one to see its cocktail photo, ingredients, opening hours and a walking directions link.
Each bar shows whether it's open now (in Edinburgh time) and when it closes or next opens.
Zoom in to see bar names on the map. Rotate the map with a two-finger twist, or right-click drag (Ctrl + drag) on a computer; the compass resets north.
The map can be maximised, and the bar list can be hidden. Areas in the list start folded.
The Cocktail Village at Festival Square has its own pin with opening times, pop-up bars and street food.
